$comment: Source rows for the check bundle (QC loop redesign 2026-09-24, workstreams 1 and 2). One row per requirement the observer measures: what to check, on which pages and states, against which source field, with which comparator and threshold, and how a finding becomes a ticket. tests/build-checks.mjs compiles these with the policy bundle (ticket class -> owner role and evidence profile), the field map, the lifecycle spec and the registries into spec/check-bundle.generated.json; the observer loads that bundle and the filer applies it. Thresholds, host lists, exemptions and grace periods live here and in the registries, never in the observer's config. Defaults below fill any field a row leaves out. A row's expected value is either a literal or a derivation (source id from sourceHealth, field, transform). decisionPending names the APEX ticket whose decision can change the row; the row carries the recommended value until then. Rows and retirements must together cover every name in registry/observer-checks.json.

pageFamilies.$comment: Row pageFamily values. Real families come from spec/page-family-requirements.json; the pseudo-families below group them for rows that run on more than one.
pageFamilies.map-source: growth map API records (the HubSpot Programs mirror) and Operations sheet rows; not a page

sourceHealth.$comment: Source ids a row may depend on. providerEntity is the entity name the observer's provider-health finding carries; registryKey is the registry/sources.json entry. A finding whose row depends on a source that is failed, degraded, disabled or stale is suppressed and counted, never filed.
